title: Research: independently audit PR #3131's first paired P104 collector at tensor multiplicity two
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independent finite audit of the first paired P104 collector from PR #3131 at actual tensor multiplicity two: n = 18, N = 262144, rank 14, events 2025–2039. The predecessor tested complete actual collectors only at N = 512 and left this larger actual payload unchecked. Two separately written exact evaluators agree on the entire outgoing value, promoted query and working grid on four deterministic signed fixtures. The five dirty source arrays remain unchanged and the private collector returns to literal zero.

All 524288 forward wrapper columns, plus their inverses, are checked against an independent strided-column implementation. Two fixtures have nonzero rounding error; cancellation and zero-sum cases test the grid boundary. The original pair/inverse and error policy are credited predecessor constructions. The new contribution is the actual tensor boundary check, source binding and discriminating controls, not a new lifting identity, fast implementation or multiplication exponent. This checks the collector's defined semantics with new code: PR #3131's own nested evaluator did not finish at this size in two 600-second attempts, so its implementation is not compared here (see Validation).

The package `research/p104-tensor-collector-audit/` contains the `README.md` derivation, the complete receipt `RESULT.json` and the task card `TASK.json`. Fast physical execution, clean-stock hosting, the full supplier bill and all-size refinement remain open. The selected frontier and frozen predecessors are unchanged; the inherited unchanged-consumer screen 599/584 remains in force.

## Task and overlap

Base: `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`. Card `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 6, track `complex-mechanisms`, original scope key `72dfbf0708467ad34793`; actual scope `PR3131-first-paired-collector-lambda2`.

Scope is **changed**, from realizing a named static endpoint collection to independently checking the explicitly unrun actual tensor boundary in PR #3131 PROOF section 7. This is one chronological restoration/precision component on the same P104 track. The static-collection and support-propagation questions already have separate investigations; this audit does not reconstruct them. The expansion-gate decision is to stop at the finite audit: no changed complete consumer or favorable new supplier bill is supplied.

The [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19001927) is in the existing collector thread. Handoffs #1166 and the canonical thread were checked before selection. The exact task card records the original catalogue card, existing checks, method, changed premise, stop rule and next obligations. Budget was one 60-minute session; bounded domain is four lambda = 2 fixtures, one lambda = 1 calibration and all addresses of the actual two outbound wrappers.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, standard library only. From repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-tensor-collector-audit --check-only
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-tensor-collector-audit
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-tensor-collector-audit
```

Observed:

```text
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
PASS_P104_TENSOR_COLLECTOR_AUDIT cases=5 no_new_kappa
Ran 8 tests ... OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-tensor-collector-audit outcome=completed
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES {"commit": "993e2d4ba993d9818c6d7c5ae1e35980d1ab3ebb", "files": 25, "package": "research/p104-tensor-collector-audit"}
```

The direct verifier compares complete arrays before digesting them. Exact Walsh ideal evaluation gives squared errors `5379503/8` and `2615337/4` in working-grid numerator units for the two rounding fixtures, at grids 3 and 5. The cancellation and zero fixtures use grids 25 and 3 and have zero error. The physical squared errors multiply these numbers by `2^(-2F)`. Exact forward and paired-inverse relative inequalities pass without floating point.

Controls include all 2401 signed pairs in [-3,3]^4, wrong layout, omitted tensor phase, reversed nonlinear stage order, wrong inverse, changed event/native binding, query promotion omitted, private return corrupted, source bytes corrupted, duplicate JSON keys and changed receipt values/types. The order witness has two different forward outputs but two successful paired cleanups. Eight behavioral groups run under `-O`, including the actual optimized CLI and four small comparisons with authenticated PR #3025 code.

**Incomplete extended comparison.** Two full retained PR #3131 nested-evaluator attempts each hit a 600-second cap (exit 124), with no completed receipt. Their explicit finite plans were `(width,d,spacing,suffix,outer)=(160,2,2,1,3)` and `(160,157,1,2,14)`. Only the finite n<=10 guard was changed to n<=18 in an authenticated in-memory copy; the arithmetic and block-planning code stayed unchanged. These attempts are not successful evidence or arithmetic counterexamples. `attempt_retained.py` preserves them as optional follow-up commands outside the registered successful replay. The predecessor's unchanged N = 512 `--suite consumers` replay passed separately, in 2.47 seconds; it does not close the N = 262144 implementation comparison.

Registered replay, metadata/pins, all eight optimized controls and the original-return ideal fixture pass. The measured direct run took 32.36 seconds and 706984 KiB maximum RSS. The working tree is checked against the publication commit `993e2d4ba993d9818c6d7c5ae1e35980d1ab3ebb`: all 25 package/input files match. The committed export passes inventory/hash validation, and the exact exported bytes also pass the complete direct replay and all eight controls with `-I -O -B` from a read-only directory outside any Git checkout.

No Lean, formal-kernel review, selected full cold replay, all-size fast implementation, lambda > 2 actual collector or PR #3134 implementation check was run. No independent human review is claimed. Finite success does not admit a complete supplier or prove a new kappa.

The two new numerical evaluators were separately written within this contribution. The small predecessor calibration and the incomplete retained-evaluator attempts deliberately execute credited code; they are not separate human reviews.

## Open next questions

The package's `README.md` (Open next questions) and `TASK.json` give three follow-ups. First, retain the unfinished nested-evaluator comparison on this same fixture: allow a measured longer replay budget or establish its separate component equivalences. Next, bind an actual fast reversible backend trace to this finite boundary, accounting for source access, snapshots, cleanup, movement and clean stock. Finally, name a changed complete P104 consumer and price every rank and hosting term before further construction. This audit supplies no favorable changed full bill; the inherited 599/584 screen is unchanged.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

Separating actual complete-collector tests from synthetic wrapper tests exposed a precise useful audit. Finite-model packages could make their executable size guard, tested actual multiplicities and replay times explicit in one small table. This would also make a bounded retained-evaluator comparison easier to plan.
